title: IVF: egg retrieval
what: Using ultrasound, the doctor takes eggs from your ovaries with a thin needle through the wall of the vagina. It is usually done during a short, medicine-induced sleep.
why: It is a step of IVF after the ovaries are stimulated. The eggs collected are fertilized in the lab.
duration: the retrieval itself usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; you are usually at the clinic for 2 to 4 hours
tell_doctor: All the medicines and injections you are taking
The exact time you had the trigger shot
If you ever had problems with anesthesia
If you have a cold or a fever now

prepare.title: Trigger shot
prepare.text: About a day and a half before retrieval, you get a shot to help the eggs mature. Your doctor sets the time. It must be done exactly on time, to the minute.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food for 6 hours and no drinks for 2 hours before retrieval. Your clinic will give you the exact time.

prepare.title: Your partner
prepare.text: If your partner gives a sperm sample the same day, usually no ejaculation for 2 to 5 days before. Check with your clinic.

prepare.title: On the day
prepare.text: Do not use perfume, cream, makeup, or nail polish. Take off jewelry and contact lenses.

steps: You change your clothes and a thin tube is put into a vein
You lie on the gynecology chair
The anesthesiologist gives you medicine, and you fall asleep
The doctor puts an ultrasound probe with a thin needle into the vagina
Fluid with an egg is drawn out of each follicle
The embryologist looks for the eggs under a microscope right away
You wake up and rest under watch for 1 to 2 hours
feel: While asleep, you usually feel nothing
Afterwards, a pulling pain low in the belly, like period cramps
Light bloody spotting for 1 to 2 days
after: Rest for the rest of the day. Do not drive
You are usually told how many eggs were collected the same day
The clinic will tell you about fertilization and embryos over the next days
No saunas, baths, sports, or sex until your doctor allows
Drink enough water, and take medicines strictly as your clinic planned
red_flags: Severe belly pain, or pain that gets worse

Your belly suddenly gets bigger, your weight goes up within a day, you are short of breath, or you pee very little. This is ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome. Call your clinic urgently or call emergency services

faq.a: It is usually done during a short sleep, so it does not hurt during the procedure. Afterwards, there is a pulling feeling low in the belly for 1 to 2 days.

faq.q: Why is the time of the trigger shot so important?
faq.a: The eggs mature an exact number of hours after the shot. If the timing is wrong, the eggs may not be collected.

reminders.text: Trigger shot today. Take it exactly at the time your clinic set. Write down the exact time of the shot.
Egg retrieval tomorrow. Eat and drink only until the time your clinic gave you. No makeup, perfume, or nail polish. Arrange for someone to take you home.
